levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث

notes: the two branches meet at «كلاهما عن ابن شهاب»: that tail is shared (rule 3)
«أبي» (Shu'ayb) and «جدي» (al-Layth) are named only by relation, so they are relation links; «أبي» is the first of two occurrences of the word
«بمثله» refers back to the saying, it is not a link: left out
